aspect: Databases copy, they do not verify
description: The error propagates from the first record into every downstream system, each of which then treats the others as corroboration.
energy_note: One typo, confirmed by four systems.

aspect: You are presumed to be the unreliable party
description: The person asserting the record is wrong is the one whose account is doubted. Institutions trust their own data over the human being in front of them.

aspect: Correction requires an original that may not exist
description: Fixing it means producing the authoritative source document from an archive that may be paper, may be in another state, and may have burned.
energy_note: Correct it by producing a document from a building that flooded.

aspect: And the age on the record governs everything
description: Where birth registration was informal, the recorded date of birth may be an estimate made by a clerk - which then determines school entry, exam eligibility, employment age limits and pension date for the rest of the life.
energy_note: A guessed birthday, governing sixty years of eligibility.

aspect: SCENARIO - the birthday a clerk chose
description: Registered at four years old, the clerk wrote 1 January because the mother gave a season rather than a date. That 1 January governs her school entry, her exam eligibility, her employment age limit, her NYSC call-up and the year she may draw a pension. It is wrong by about eight months.
energy_note: Sixty years of eligibility, resting on a guess.
